rubric_items.reason: All 12 known REQs (REQ-1..REQ-12) are traced by at least one story; no assumed REQs exist.
Stories are mostly one outcome each; S-6 bundles list display, page display and the Stale filter (REQ-10 and REQ-11).
ACs are Given/When/Then with exact 24h boundary (10:00 vs 09:59) and a local/UTC split date case; gaps: per-patient overlap partition untested, S-3 AC1 'its time' vague, no positive TZ-boundary AC.
24h after start, Asia/Kolkata, actor system and Scheduled again all come from the intent; the UTC+05:30 conversion is derived inline; dates are example values.
Readable with consistent state names; minor ambiguity in S-3 AC1 and AC1/AC2 of S-1 not stating local or UTC times.

findings.text: REQ-7 says a rescheduled Stale appointment counts for the booking overlap rules, which apply per doctor and per patient; S-5 tests only the per-doctor overlap, leaving the per-patient partition unchecked.

cites.quote: when staff try to book another patient with doctor D at 10:00 on 5 December
appointments per doctor and per patient

findings.suggested_fix: Add an AC: the same patient booked with another doctor at 10:00 on 5 December is refused as an overlap.

findings.text: S-3 AC1 says the event holds the change 'with its time' without saying which time (moment of the change vs appointment start), so a wrong timestamp would still pass.

cites.quote: then it holds an entry for the change to Stale with its time.

findings.suggested_fix: State the expected time, e.g. the event time is the instant it was marked Stale (10:00 on 2 December for a 10:00 on 1 December start).

findings.text: The time-zone case in S-1 only checks the negative side (still Scheduled at 00:30 local); no AC asserts it becomes Stale at 01:00 local on 4 December, so an offset error that marks Stale late passes.

cites.quote: when it is checked at 00:30 local on 4 December

findings.suggested_fix: Add: at 01:00 local on 4 December (19:30 UTC on 3 December) its state is Stale.

findings.text: S-6 bundles three outcomes (list row, appointment page, Stale filter) from two REQs; the filter (REQ-11) could be its own story.

cites.quote: Staff see Stale appointments in the list and on the appointment page
A Scheduled appointment that is still Scheduled `24h after start` time is marked Stale.
The appointment_event row for marking Stale carries the actor `system`.
The hospital time zone is `Asia/Kolkata`; instants are stored in UTC.
it is then `Scheduled again` at its new time and counts for the booking overlap rules.
An appointment called off before it took place, with a reason
